item.title: SWE-Proof: Can Language Models Resolve Real-World Issues with Machine-Checked Proofs?
item.description:
中文标题：SWE-Proof：语言模型能否用机器可检验证明解决真实世界问题？

作者：George Ma, Benjamin Mikek, Haoyu Li, Ferhat Erata, Yuhao Zhang, Zeren Shui, Behrooz Omidvar Tehrani, Jun Huan, Murali Krishna Ramanathan, Somayeh Sojoudi, Hao Zhou, Anoop Deoras

Abstract: Ensuring the correctness of LLM-generated code is a core challenge for modern software engineering. Benchmarks for agentic code generation check correctness with held-out test suites, which are inherently incomplete and increasingly susceptible to memorization. Formal verification avoids both problems, but existing work covers only standalone tasks whose specifications are given as input, not real issues, which touch large repositories and state intent in vague natural language. We present Benchproofer, a pipeline that turns a coding task with a known correct patch into a formally verified one: it writes a specification for the new code, summarizes the existing functions that code calls with axioms, and admits an instance only after mechanical and adversarial gates agree. Applying it to SWE-bench Verified yields SWE-Proof, 500 real issues whose correctness is formally verified rather than tested, and it extends to SWE-bench Pro. Across two frontier models, verification catches what tests miss: a quarter to a half of test-passing patches admit counterexamples, which a structured natural-language specification does not fix, while a correct formal one lifts resolution from 85% to 95% for Opus 4.8. Writing that specification is the hard part: models that must write their own gain nothing over an unaided baseline, and only 62% of their specifications pass our audit. The usual failure is faithfulness, a specification that constrains part of the required behavior and leaves the rest free. Specification quality still tracks the outcome, failing on 89% of unresolved instances against 47% of resolved ones, making faithful specification synthesis a concrete open problem.

中文摘要：确保LLM生成代码的正确性是现代软件工程的核心挑战。智能体代码生成的基准测试通常用留出测试套件检查正确性，但测试套件本质上不完整且越来越容易被记忆。形式化验证可避免这两个问题，但现有工作仅覆盖规范作为输入给出的独立任务，而非涉及大型仓库且以模糊自然语言表达意图的真实问题。我们提出Benchproofer，一个将已知正确补丁的编码任务转化为形式化验证任务的流水线：它为新增代码编写规范，用公理概括被调用现有函数，并且只有在机械门和对抗门都同意后才接纳一个实例。将其应用于SWE-bench Verified后得到SWE-Proof，包含500个真实问题，其正确性通过形式化验证而非测试来确认，并可扩展到SWE-bench Pro。在两个前沿模型上，验证能捕捉测试遗漏的问题：四分之一到一半的测试通过补丁存在反例，结构化自然语言规范无法解决这一问题，而正确的形式化规范将Opus 4.8的解决率从85%提升到95%。编写该规范是难点：必须自行编写规范的模型相比无辅助基线没有增益，且其规范只有62%通过审计。常见失败是忠实性不足，即规范只约束了部分所需行为而放任其余部分。规范质量仍与结果相关，未解决实例的失败率为89%，而已解决实例为47%，这使得忠实规范合成成为一个具体的开放问题。

研究启发（模型推断）：形式化验证可提升LLM生成代码的可靠性，但其对规范编写质量的依赖提示在GIS自动化分析流程中需谨慎对待LLM生成代码的正确性保证。

相关度：45/100 该文关注LLM生成代码的形式化验证，与LLM研究相关，但与GIS、城市更新或遥感无直接联系。

item.title: When Better Turns Do Not Make Better Agents: Diagnosing the Gap Between Next-Turn Metrics and Workflow Success
item.description:
中文标题：当更好的轮次并不造就更好的智能体：诊断下一轮指标与工作流成功之间的差距

作者：Md Tahmid Rahman Laskar, Xue-Yong Fu, Gundeep Singh, Karol Chang, Kevin Sanders, Shi Zong, Tania Habib, Julien Bouvier Tremblay, Shayna Gardiner, Harsh Saini, Matthias Lee, Elena Khasanova, Quinten McNamara, Shashi Bhushan TN

Abstract: Agent models are frequently evaluated one decision at a time, where the model predicts the next action based on the gold interaction history, which is scored against a reference. We investigate whether improvement under this protocol is predictive of improved autonomous workflow execution. We study pre-SFT and supervised fine-tuned (SFT) Qwen3 models at 4B and 14B parameters and Gemma 3 models at 4B and 12B parameters on multi-turn customer-support workflows. We find that SFT consistently improves text-turn success, and that overall next-turn success increases for every model under gold-history evaluation. However, these improvements do not transfer to autonomous workflow execution. Tool-specific gains also vary across metrics and models. None of the four SFT models succeeds under holistic workflow evaluation, with strict trajectory completion reaching at most 10.4% workflow success. Our results show that next-turn evaluation is not a reliable proxy for workflow success, motivating separate reporting of text quality, local action correctness, tool execution, and end-to-end task completion.

中文摘要：智能体模型常以单次决策方式评估，即模型基于金标准交互历史预测下一动作，并与参考进行评分。我们研究该协议下的改进是否能预测自主工作流执行的改善。我们研究预SFT和监督微调（SFT）的Qwen3模型（4B和14B参数）以及Gemma 3模型（4B和12B参数）在多轮客户支持工作流上的表现。我们发现SFT持续提升文本轮次成功率，且在金标准历史评估下所有模型的整体下一轮成功率均提高。然而，这些改进并未迁移到自主工作流执行。工具特定增益也因指标和模型而异。四个SFT模型均未在整体工作流评估中成功，严格轨迹完成的工作流成功率最高仅为10.4%。结果表明下一轮评估不是工作流成功的可靠代理，因此有必要分别报告文本质量、局部动作正确性、工具执行和端到端任务完成情况。

研究启发（模型推断）：该研究提示在构建基于LLM的多智能体地理空间工作流时，局部动作指标的提升未必带来端到端任务成功，需要设计面向完整工作流的评估体系。

相关度：55/100 该文研究LLM智能体在多轮工作流中的评估问题，与LLM和多智能体研究方向相关，但未涉及地理空间应用。

We study pre-SFT and supervised fine-tuned (SFT) Qwen3 models at 4B and 14B parameters and Gemma 3 models at 4B and 12B parameters on multi-turn customer-support workflows. We find that SFT consistently improves text-turn success, and that overall next-turn success increases for every model under gold-history evaluation. However, these improvements do not transfer to autonomous workflow execution. Tool-specific gains also vary across metrics and models. None of the four SFT models succeeds under holistic workflow evaluation, with strict trajectory completion reaching at most 10.4% workflow success. Our results show that next-turn evaluation is not a reliable proxy for workflow success, motivating separate reporting of text quality, local action correctness, tool execution, and end-to-end task completion.

中文摘要：智能体模型常以单次决策方式评估，即模型基于金标准交互历史预测下一动作，并与参考进行评分。我们研究该协议下的改进是否能预测自主工作流执行的改善。我们研究预SFT和监督微调（SFT）的Qwen3模型（4B和14B参数）以及Gemma 3模型（4B和12B参数）在多轮客户支持工作流上的表现。我们发现SFT持续提升文本轮次成功率，且在金标准历史评估下所有模型的整体下一轮成功率均提高。然而，这些改进并未迁移到自主工作流执行。工具特定增益也因指标和模型而异。四个SFT模型均未在整体工作流评估中成功，严格轨迹完成的工作流成功率最高仅为10.4%。结果表明下一轮评估不是工作流成功的可靠代理，因此有必要分别报告文本质量、局部动作正确性、工具执行和端到端任务完成情况。

研究启发（模型推断）：该研究提示在构建基于LLM的多智能体地理空间工作流时，局部动作指标的提升未必带来端到端任务成功，需要设计面向完整工作流的评估体系。

item.title: M2G-LLM: Enhancing Clinical Prediction via Multimodal Graph Reasoning and LLM Context Injection
item.description:
中文标题：M2G-LLM：通过多模态图推理与LLM上下文注入增强临床预测

作者：Inyoung Choi, Sukwon Yun, Jiayi Xin, Jie Peng, Tianlong Chen, Qi Long

Abstract: Integrating diverse data modalities --- such as clinical notes, laboratory results, and medical imaging --- is essential for advancing clinical decision-making. While Large Language Models (LLMs) have shown remarkable performance in processing unstructured clinical text, their limited capacity to incorporate non-text modalities hinders their broader utility in healthcare applications. Here, we introduce M2G-LLM (Multimodal MedGraph-LLM), a novel framework that enhances LLMs with multimodal integration and alignment via Graph Neural Networks (GNNs). Our approach models temporal relationships between patient visits, propagates information across clinically similar patients, and aligns heterogeneous data sources to construct enriched multimodal context vectors. These vectors are injected into the intermediate layers of the LLM, enabling joint reasoning over textual and non-textual modalities. We evaluate M2G-LLM on the MIMIC-IV and MIMIC-CXR datasets, demonstrating improvements in clinical prediction tasks over strong baseline models. Our results highlight the promise of combining the language understanding of LLMs with the relational reasoning capabilities of GNNs for comprehensive, multimodal healthcare analysis.

中文摘要：整合临床笔记、实验室结果和医学影像等多种数据模态对于推进临床决策至关重要。尽管大型语言模型（LLM）在处理非结构化临床文本方面表现出色，但其纳入非文本模态的能力有限，阻碍了其在医疗应用中的更广泛效用。在此，我们提出M2G-LLM（多模态医学图-LLM），一个通过图神经网络（GNN）增强LLM多模态整合与对齐的新颖框架。我们的方法建模患者就诊之间的时间关系，在临床相似患者之间传播信息，并对齐异构数据源以构建丰富的多模态上下文向量。这些向量被注入LLM的中间层，实现对文本和非文本模态的联合推理。我们在MIMIC-IV和MIMIC-CXR数据集上评估M2G-LLM，证明其在临床预测任务上优于强基线模型。结果凸显了将LLM的语言理解能力与GNN的关系推理能力相结合用于全面多模态医疗分析的潜力。

研究启发（模型推断）：GNN与LLM中间层注入相结合的多模态融合范式，可启发地理空间智能中遥感影像、文本报告与图结构数据的联合推理，但需适配地理时空关系。

相关度：50/100 该文提出多模态图推理与LLM上下文注入框架，涉及多源数据融合与LLM结合，与研究中多源数据融合方向有方法关联，但应用领域为临床医学。

item.title: Signal-Centric Remote Sensing via Alternative Preprocessing and Acoustic Processing for ML-Driven Applications
item.description:
中文标题：以信号为中心的遥感：面向机器学习应用的替代预处理与声学处理方法

作者：Logan Luna, Sirio Jansen-S\'anchez, Ilteris Demirkiran, Leo Ghelarducci

Abstract: The dominant method of processing sonar data is using image-based representations, requiring the preprocessing of image data on autonomous systems. We propose an alternative data processing method for remote sensing applications via the use of data in Comma-Seperated Value format. Experimentation on our alternative approach shows a reduction of processing time by 91.18%, an improvement in accurate object detection by Machine Learning, and an increase in SNR (Signal-to-noise ratio), PSNR (Peak signal-to-noise ratio), and other evaluation metrics.

中文摘要：声纳数据的主流处理方式是使用图像表示，这需要在自主系统上对图像数据进行预处理。该文提出一种替代的数据处理方法，即在遥感应用中使用逗号分隔值（CSV）格式的数据。实验表明，该替代方法将处理时间减少91.18%，提升了机器学习目标检测的准确性，并提高了信噪比（SNR）、峰值信噪比（PSNR）等评价指标。

研究启发（模型推断）：该文提示，在遥感与声纳等信号处理场景中，绕过图像化预处理、直接使用信号格式数据可能显著降低处理时间并改善检测与信噪比指标，为机器学习驱动的遥感应用提供了替代预处理思路。

相关度：55/100 该文提出以CSV格式数据替代图像表示的遥感数据处理方法，并借鉴声学处理，涉及遥感信号处理与机器学习应用，与遥感变化检测和多源数据融合有一定关联，但未涉及变化检测或地理空间语义。

item.title: Image-Derived PM10 Estimation in Cattle Feedlot Using Machine Learning: Addressing Concentration Ranges Beyond Existing Digital Imaging Methods
item.description:
中文标题：基于图像的养牛场PM10估算：面向超越现有数字成像方法的浓度范围

作者：Sirapoom Peanusaha, Greg B. Ferguson, K. Jack Bush, Peiyang Li, Brent W. Auvermann

Abstract: Affordable dust monitoring remains a pressing need for the cattle feedlot industry, yet camera-based PM estimation, despite its growing body of research in urban air quality settings, has not been evaluated under the extended concentration ranges characteristic of intensive livestock operations. This study developed an image-based approach using contrast panel features and machine learning to estimate PM10 concentrations in a commercial cattle feedlot, where hourly average PM10 ranged from 250 to 1,000 ug/m^-3 and instantaneous concentrations reached 5,000 to 20,000 ug/m^-3. Grayscale images were captured during the evening dust peak period, and features including panel contrast, black and white panel pixel values, and overall image brightness were extracted. The model also incorporated recent past values from preceding images and solar zenith angle as predictors. Among the candidate models evaluated, XGBoost achieved the highest predictive performance, with an R^2 of 0.792 and a median absolute error of 103 ug/m^-3. Feature importance analysis revealed that (a) panels positioned farthest from the camera contributed most strongly to predictions and (b) that black panel pixel values were more sensitive than white panel values to changes in PM10 concentration. Prediction accuracy during the sunset transition, which coincides with the onset of the feedlot evening dust peak, remains an area for further refinement. These findings demonstrate the feasibility of image-based PM10 estimation across PM concentration ranges substantially exceeding those reported in prior urban studies and provide practical guidelines for future deployment in feedlot environments.

中文摘要：经济实惠的粉尘监测仍是养牛业迫切需求，然而尽管基于相机的PM估算在城市空气质量研究中日益增多，其尚未在集约化畜牧作业特有的扩展浓度范围内得到评估。本研究开发了一种基于图像的方法，利用对比面板特征和机器学习估算商业养牛场的PM10浓度，其中小时平均PM10范围为250至1000 μg/m^-3，瞬时浓度可达5000至20000 μg/m^-3。灰度图像在傍晚粉尘峰值时段采集，提取的特征包括面板对比度、黑白面板像素值以及整体图像亮度。模型还纳入前序图像的近期历史值和太阳天顶角作为预测因子。在候选模型中，XGBoost取得最高预测性能，R^2为0.792，中位绝对误差为103 μg/m^-3。特征重要性分析显示：(a) 距相机最远的面板对预测贡献最大；(b) 黑色面板像素值比白色面板值对PM10浓度变化更敏感。日落过渡时段的预测精度（恰逢养牛场傍晚粉尘峰值开始）仍有待进一步改进。这些发现证明了在远超以往城市研究报告的PM浓度范围内进行基于图像的PM10估算的可行性，并为未来在养牛场环境中的部署提供了实用指南。

研究启发（模型推断）：该工作展示了图像特征与机器学习在极高浓度粉尘环境中的PM10估算可行性，其对比面板与光照因子设计或可迁移至遥感影像的大气颗粒物监测，但摘要未涉及卫星遥感或城市尺度应用。

相关度：55/100 该文利用图像特征与机器学习估算养牛场PM10浓度，属于环境遥感与图像监测交叉方向，与遥感变化检测、多源数据融合及地理空间智能有一定方法学关联，但应用场景为畜牧环境而非城市更新。

item.title: Rethinking Multi-Agent Collaboration: When More Is Less
item.description:
中文标题：重新思考多智能体协作：更多未必更好

作者：Yishuo Yuan, Yibo Wu, Yihan Zhang, Minyuan Sun, Shenliang Li, Xinkai Ma, Yifan Li, Jiaheng Liu

Abstract: The rapid advancement of large language models and single-agent harnesses has reshaped the landscape of autonomous systems, raising a critical question of when multi-agent collaboration offers genuine value. As individual agent capabilities continue to scale, multi-agent collaboration faces diminishing returns while incurring growing context overhead. Through systematic analysis, we delineate the capability boundaries of multi-agent collaboration relative to single-agent alternatives, showing that it confers systematic benefits specifically in long-horizon tasks with sparse dependencies, while single-agent harnesses remain superior in tightly coupled, sequential workflows. Building on these insights, we propose SAIGE, a lightweight multi-agent collaboration mechanism based on Semantic-Aware Incremental Graph Evolution. SAIGE models collaboration as a dynamically evolving graph, where nodes are agent instances spawned on demand and edges encode semantic dependencies established through content-based information retrieval. Experiments on long-horizon, complex task benchmarks show that SAIGE achieves a favorable trade-off between context efficiency and task performance, and that scaling the agent pool or deepening the recursion level does not consistently improve outcomes. Our findings suggest that multi-agent superiority is bounded by task structure rather than universal, and that more agents do not necessarily make a system more intelligent.

中文摘要：大语言模型和单智能体框架的快速发展重塑了自主系统的格局，由此引出一个关键问题：多智能体协作何时能带来真正价值。随着单个智能体能力持续扩展，多智能体协作面临收益递减，同时上下文开销不断增长。通过系统分析，作者刻画了多智能体协作相对于单智能体方案的能力边界，表明其在具有稀疏依赖的长时程任务中具有系统性优势，而在紧耦合的顺序工作流中单智能体框架仍更优。基于这些洞见，作者提出SAIGE，一种基于语义感知增量图演化的轻量级多智能体协作机制。SAIGE将协作建模为动态演化的图，节点是按需生成的智能体实例，边编码通过基于内容的信息检索建立的语义依赖。在长时程复杂任务基准上的实验表明，SAIGE在上下文效率与任务性能之间取得良好权衡，且扩大智能体池或加深递归层级并不总能持续改善结果。研究结果表明，多智能体的优越性受任务结构约束而非普遍成立，更多智能体并不必然使系统更智能。

研究启发（模型推断）：该研究提示，在城市更新等复杂时空任务中引入多智能体协作时，应优先考虑任务是否具有长时程、稀疏依赖的结构特征，而非盲目增加智能体数量；语义感知的图演化机制或可迁移用于地理空间智能中的多源信息协同。

相关度：62/100 该文系统分析多智能体协作的能力边界，并提出基于语义感知增量图演化的协作机制，与研究中LLM和多智能体方向直接相关，但未涉及地理空间或城市更新应用。

item.title: PerSeM: Persistent Semantic Memory for Long-Horizon Open-Vocabulary UAV Mapping
item.description:
中文标题：PerSeM：面向长时程开放词汇无人机建图的持久语义记忆

作者：Saurbh Singh Jamwal, Ganesh Ramakrishnan

Abstract: Open-vocabulary segmentation enables rich semantic perception for UAVs, but frame-wise predictions can remain temporally inconsistent across repeated observations and changing viewpoints. We present PerSeM, a training-free persistent semantic memory framework for long-horizon open-vocabulary UAV mapping. PerSeM associates frame-wise semantic observations with persistent world-space voxels and constructs a majority-based semantic memory, which is conservatively refined through history-preserving spatial refinement, trust-aware replay, and context-guided verification. Experiments on the Forest and UAVScenes benchmarks show that persistent 3D memory provides substantial gains in semantic correctness and temporal stability over frame-wise predictions. Beyond this strong persistent-memory baseline, PerSeM provides consistent additional improvements, improving both semantic accuracy and temporal stability across all five evaluated UAVScenes sequences. Analysis using regions identified independently of the final PerSeM predictions further shows that these gains are concentrated in semantically difficult and temporally unstable regions, where majority-based memory is most likely to remain uncertain. These results demonstrate that persistent 3D aggregation provides a strong foundation for long-horizon semantic mapping, while conservative refinement of uncertain memory states can provide additional improvements without retraining or additional neural-network inference.

中文摘要：开放词汇分割为无人机提供了丰富的语义感知能力，但逐帧预测在重复观测和视角变化下可能保持时间上不一致。作者提出PerSeM，一种无需训练的持久语义记忆框架，用于长时程开放词汇无人机建图。PerSeM将逐帧语义观测关联到持久的世界空间体素，构建基于多数投票的语义记忆，并通过保留历史的空间精化、信任感知重放和上下文引导验证进行保守细化。在Forest和UAVScenes基准上的实验表明，持久三维记忆在语义正确性和时间稳定性上相较逐帧预测有显著提升。除这一强持久记忆基线外，PerSeM还提供一致的额外改进，在全部五个评估的UAVScenes序列上同时提升语义精度和时间稳定性。使用独立于最终PerSeM预测识别的区域进行分析进一步表明，这些增益集中在语义困难和时间不稳定的区域，即基于多数投票的记忆最可能保持不确定的地方。这些结果表明，持久三维聚合为长时程语义建图提供了坚实基础，而对不确定记忆状态的保守细化可在无需重新训练或额外神经网络推理的情况下带来额外改进。

研究启发（模型推断）：该框架的持久三维语义记忆与保守细化策略，可为遥感变化检测中的时序一致性问题和多源数据融合中的不确定性处理提供方法借鉴，尤其适用于观测视角多变、语义模糊的城市遥感场景。

相关度：78/100 该文提出面向长时程开放词汇无人机建图的持久语义记忆框架，涉及三维体素聚合与语义一致性，与遥感变化检测和多源数据融合方向高度相关。

item.title: Proxifield: Decentralized Multi-Agent Communication through Semantic Proximity
item.description:
中文标题：Proxifield：通过语义邻近实现的去中心化多智能体通信

作者：Pradyumna Tambwekar, Yenchia Feng, Deep Patel, Karime Maamari

Abstract: As LLM capabilities have expanded, multi-agent communication has emerged as an increasingly active area of research. Prevailing protocols often adopt rigid structures that introduce coordination bottlenecks and can degrade as the number of agents increases. We introduce Proxifield, a round-adaptive multi-agent protocol with decentralized agent decision-making that constructs sparse communication graphs from the evolving semantic proximity of agents. Without model training or a centralized planner, Proxifield connects agents using four routing signals derived at inference time: direct address, information needs, plan alignment, and information complementarity. We compare Proxifield with two representative coordination baselines, a centralized Star protocol and a decentralized Shared Context protocol, across two domains: Drone Search and Rescue and the collective-reasoning benchmark HiddenBench. We first ablate base-model capability and find that, in both domains, the performance of Proxifield improves with model size (35B -> 397B parameter model) and Proxifield outperforms all baselines at the largest scale. As team size increases, Proxifield's task-reward advantage over Star widens from 5.4% at (N=5) to 53.0% at (N=25) and 59.5% at (N=50), while Shared Context consistently underperforms both protocols. Proxifield is also substantially more robust to permanent agent failure, retaining 73.6% of its no-failure task reward under the most severe condition, compared with 58.3% for Shared Context and 38.8% for Star. These results demonstrate that decentralized, semantically adaptive routing can improve the scalability and fault tolerance of multi-agent systems.

中文摘要：随着大语言模型能力的扩展，多智能体通信已成为日益活跃的研究领域。主流协议往往采用刚性结构，引入协调瓶颈，并可能随智能体数量增加而性能退化。作者提出Proxifield，一种具有去中心化智能体决策的轮次自适应多智能体协议，从智能体不断演化的语义邻近性构建稀疏通信图。无需模型训练或集中式规划器，Proxifield在推理时使用四种路由信号连接智能体：直接寻址、信息需求、计划对齐和信息互补性。作者在两个领域将Proxifield与两种代表性协调基线（集中式Star协议和去中心化Shared Context协议）进行比较：无人机搜救和集体推理基准HiddenBench。首先消融基础模型能力，发现在两个领域中Proxifield的性能随模型规模提升（35B至397B参数模型），且在最大规模下优于所有基线。随着团队规模增加，Proxifield相对Star的任务奖励优势从N=5时的5.4%扩大到N=25时的53.0%和N=50时的59.5%，而Shared Context始终表现不及两种协议。Proxifield对永久性智能体故障也具有显著更强的鲁棒性，在最严重条件下保留其无故障任务奖励的73.6%，而Shared Context为58.3%，Star为38.8%。这些结果表明，去中心化、语义自适应的路由可提升多智能体系统的可扩展性和容错性。

研究启发（模型推断）：该协议的去中心化语义路由思路，可为城市更新中分布式传感器网络或多无人机协同观测的通信架构设计提供参考，其容错性优势对存在节点失效风险的地理空间感知系统具有潜在价值。

相关度：58/100 该文提出基于语义邻近的去中心化多智能体通信协议，并在无人机搜救场景中验证，与LLM和多智能体方向相关，且涉及无人机应用，但核心贡献在通信协议而非地理空间分析。

item.title: BirdsongChat: A Hybrid Multi-Agent Framework for Multimodal Embodied Behavior Simulation
item.description:
中文标题：BirdsongChat：面向多模态具身行为模拟的混合多智能体框架

作者：Callie C. Liao, Duoduo Liao, Ellie L. Zhang

Abstract: Multimodal embodied systems require translating human intentions into interpretable and coordinated behaviors across heterogeneous modalities. However, existing multimodal agents often rely on implicit representations, limiting controllability and cross-modal consistency. We present a hybrid multi-agent framework for interactive multimodal behavior simulation that bridges semantic reasoning and physical execution through a Unified Parameter Representation (UPR). LLM-based reasoning agents transform multimodal inputs into UPR, which encodes behavioral states and interpretable control parameters for simulation agents generating synchronized 3D motion, spatialized soundscapes, and environmental behaviors. We develop BirdsongChat as a prototype implementation of the proposed framework, using interactive avian behavior simulation as a testbed that tightly couples motion, vocalization, and environmental context. BirdsongChat is evaluated on text- and image-guided scenarios involving species, behaviors, affective states, environments, and multi-bird interactions. The system achieves normalized scores of 94.4\% for cross-modal coherence, 100% for affective consistency, and 92.6% for generation consistency. These results demonstrate that an explicit intermediate representation effectively bridges semantic reasoning and physical execution, improving controllability and multimodal synchronization. The proposed framework thus offers a generalizable design principle for embodied AI systems requiring interpretable semantic-to-physical coordination across modalities, with potential applications in bio-inspired ecoacoustics, swarm robotics, virtual environments, and creative multimedia.

中文摘要：多模态具身系统需要将人类意图转化为跨异构模态的可解释且协调的行为。然而，现有多模态智能体往往依赖隐式表示，限制了可控性和跨模态一致性。作者提出一种混合多智能体框架，用于交互式多模态行为模拟，通过统一参数表示（UPR）桥接语义推理与物理执行。基于LLM的推理智能体将多模态输入转化为UPR，UPR编码行为状态和可解释的控制参数，供模拟智能体生成同步的三维运动、空间化声景和环境行为。作者开发BirdsongChat作为所提框架的原型实现，以交互式鸟类行为模拟作为紧密耦合运动、发声和环境背景的测试平台。BirdsongChat在涉及物种、行为、情感状态、环境和多鸟交互的文本和图像引导场景中进行评估。系统在跨模态一致性上达到94.4%的归一化分数，情感一致性为100%，生成一致性为92.6%。这些结果表明，显式中间表示有效桥接了语义推理与物理执行，提升了可控性和多模态同步性。所提框架因此为需要在多模态间进行可解释语义到物理协调的具身AI系统提供了可推广的设计原则，在仿生生态声学、群体机器人、虚拟环境和创意多媒体中具有潜在应用。

研究启发（模型推断）：其显式中间表示桥接语义推理与物理执行的设计原则，或可启发城市更新模拟中人类意图到空间行为的可解释转化，但当前应用场景与地理空间智能的直接关联有限。

相关度：45/100 该文提出混合多智能体框架用于多模态具身行为模拟，涉及LLM推理与物理执行的桥接，与LLM和多智能体方向相关，但应用场景为鸟类行为模拟，与地理空间智能关联较弱。

相关度：45/100 该文提出混合多智能体框架用于多模态具身行为模拟，涉及LLM推理与物理执行的桥接，与LLM和多智能体方向相关，但应用场景为鸟类行为模拟，与地理空间智能关联较弱。

item.title: Attributing Cohen's d: Training Data Attribution for Disease-Related Effects in Normative Age Biomarkers
item.description:
中文标题：归因Cohen's d：规范年龄生物标志物中疾病相关效应的训练数据归因

作者：Jakob Snel, Marc-Andre Schulz

Abstract: Normative age models are trained to predict chronological age in a nominally healthy cohort. Applied to patients, they deviate, and the gap between predicted and chronological age is read as disease risk. Here, we attribute the disease-related effect size of the age gap directly to individual training samples, rather than using a prediction-level loss as the attribution target. For Cohen's $d$, the resulting closed-form influence functional, validated against leave-one-out retraining, ranks training samples by their effect on held-out case-control separation. Across four diseases and two biomarker modalities in UK Biobank, removing the 10% most influential training samples raises held-out disease-related effect size in every seed. It more than doubles the metabolomic-age effect for type-2 diabetes and raises the brain-age effect for multiple sclerosis by roughly a third. Random removal leaves effect size flat even at 50% removal, confirming the gain comes from which samples are removed, not how many. Flagged subjects carry subclinical cardiometabolic burden that diagnosis-based exclusion misses, on markers the model never sees. For type-2 diabetes, where the method gains most, the marker recovered is HbA1c, the standard measure of blood sugar control. We release pyinfluence, our influence-function package, for reproducibility and reuse.

中文摘要：论文提出一种新的影响函数，将年龄差距的疾病相关效应大小（Cohen's d）直接归因于单个训练样本。在UK Biobank的四种疾病和两种生物标志物模态上，移除最具影响力的10%训练样本可提高所有种子下的留出疾病相关效应。对于2型糖尿病，代谢组学年龄效应提升超过一倍；对于多发性硬化症，脑龄效应提升约三分之一。被标记的受试者携带模型未见过的亚临床心血管代谢负担。

研究启发（模型推断）：该方法通过识别并移除对病例-对照分离有负面影响的训练样本，能有效提升规范年龄模型的疾病风险预测能力，并可能发现基于诊断排除所遗漏的亚临床疾病标志物。

相关度：75/100 论文提出将疾病相关效应归因于训练样本的方法，应用于UK Biobank的脑部MRI和代谢组学数据，与医学影像分析和数据挖掘方法相关，对多源数据融合有参考价值。

item.title: TabScope: Question-Adaptive Scope Selection for Table Question Answering
item.description:
中文标题：TabScope：表格问答中的问题自适应范围选择

作者：Yuxiang Wang, Junhao Gan, Jianzhong Qi

Abstract: Large Language Models (LLMs) have shown strong performance on table question answering, yet their accuracy often degrades as table size increases. We find that this degradation is not uniform across question types. Localization-sensitive questions are particularly affected by irrelevant table content, while questions requiring broader evidence may still benefit from full-table reasoning. Based on this observation, we propose a question-adaptive framework that dynamically selects between localized and full-table reasoning. The framework constructs question-specific sub-tables through operation-aware table decomposition and uses the predicted question type to determine the appropriate reasoning mode. We further introduce silver reference sub-tables for evaluating evidence selection and construct SLQA, a benchmark based on real-world long tables. Experiments on WikiTQ and SLQA show that localization is particularly effective for lookup and local reasoning questions, while adaptive selection between localized and full-table reasoning achieves the best overall performance. These results highlight that long-table QA requires deciding not only how to localize, but also when to localize. Our code and datasets will be made available upon publication of the paper.

中文摘要：提出问题自适应框架，根据问题类型动态选择局部或全表推理，在长表格问答中取得最佳性能，并构建了SLQA基准。

研究启发（模型推断）：长表格问答的关键不仅在于如何定位，还在于何时定位，问题类型决定了推理模式的选择。

相关度：50/100 研究长表格问答中的自适应范围选择，涉及LLM推理策略，与处理大规模地理数据表格有一定关联。

item.title: What Remains Normal? Clean Images Miss Useful Near-Defect Normal Patches for Anomaly Detection
item.description:
中文标题：什么仍然正常？干净图像遗漏了用于异常检测的有用近缺陷正常补丁

作者：Joongwon Chae, Runming Wang, Peiwu Qin

Abstract: Memory-based anomaly detectors store nominal training patches and score test patches against this memory. A patch selected for coverage therefore becomes a nor- mal reference without a separate check that geometric rarity makes it safe to trust. We probe this coupling with sparse training contamination. Under fixed representa- tions and memory budgets, we compare random, medoid, local, and global coverage selectors. We then use CLEANCON, an out-of-bag cross-image support gate that changes candidate-image eligibility while fixing the representation, absolute mem- ory size, builder, and inference rule. Global coverage strongly over-represents sparse contamination. CLEANCON reduces final-memory contamination to approx- imately zero and increases category-macro P-AP in all 12 matched comparisons. Yet along a retention sweep, the lowest-contamination memory does not attain the highest P-AP; performance continues to improve while contamination rises. Mem- ory contamination therefore does not order the resulting memories by P-AP.Code is publicly available at https://github.com/jw-chae/cleancon.

中文摘要：本文探讨记忆库异常检测中稀疏训练污染的影响，发现全局覆盖选择会过度代表污染，并提出CLEANCON门控方法减少污染，但最低污染记忆并非性能最优。

研究启发（模型推断）：记忆库的污染程度与检测性能并非单调相关，过度清理可能损失有用信息，这提示在遥感变化检测中需平衡样本纯净度与信息完整性。

相关度：75/100 研究记忆库异常检测中训练污染对记忆组成的影响，提出清理方法，与遥感变化检测中的异常识别和样本质量控制高度相关。

item.title: Measuring Digital Labour Market Transitions with a Digital Semantic Score: An AI-Based Methodology Applied to the Dutch Labour Market
item.description:
中文标题：利用数字语义评分衡量数字劳动力市场转型：一种基于AI的方法应用于荷兰劳动力市场

作者：Sadegh Shahmohammadi, Xavier Pinho, Mairi Bowdler, Suhendan Adiguzel-van Zoelen, Joost van Genabeek

Abstract: ------------------------------------------------------------------------------

中文摘要：本研究提出一种基于AI的方法，利用嵌入相似性搜索和LLM分类，将数百万荷兰职位档案的非结构化信息映射到统一的ESCO职业分类，并引入数字语义评分来衡量职位名称和技能与数字概念的关联强度。该方法超越了基于关键词的方法，能够分析职业、职业转换、新兴职位词汇和技能数字化程度。研究发现数字化在劳动力市场中分布不均，数字职位语言在管理、专业和ICT职业中最为突出，但在混合业务、营销和自动化相关角色中日益可见。职业转换分析表明向数字工作的流动依赖于路径，技能分析则凸显了数字能力的多维性。

研究启发（模型推断）：该研究展示了如何将LLM和嵌入技术应用于大规模社会经济数据，以揭示数字转型的结构性特征，其方法论可迁移至其他领域的地理空间文本分析。

相关度：75/100 该研究利用AI方法（嵌入与大语言模型）分析劳动力市场的数字化转型，与GIS博士研究中关于时空数据挖掘和LLM应用的主题高度相关，为城市更新中的人力资本动态提供了方法论参考。

item.title: Consolidating RLVR Capabilities Across Domains: A Deep Dive into Fusion Paradigms
item.description:
中文标题：跨领域整合RLVR能力：融合范式的深入研究

作者：Siye Wu, Kai Yang, Yuchen Cai, Xin Xu, Peng-Yuan Wang, Jiaxuan Wang, Jiashun Liu, Jiafei Lyu, Yangkun Chen, Saiyong Yang, Yanghua Xiao

Abstract: ------------------------------------------------------------------------------

中文摘要：该研究比较了Merge、Mix RL和MOPD三种融合范式，发现它们平均性能差异不大，但单基准上差距可达8.6点。训练动态显示不同约束，并给出了实际选择指南：已有专家时用Merge，无专家时用Mix RL，需保留领域特定增益时用MOPD。

研究启发（模型推断）：不同融合范式各有优劣，选择取决于具体场景和资源约束，这为多领域智能体能力整合提供了实用指导。

相关度：55/100 该论文比较了三种RLVR能力融合范式，涉及多智能体训练和模型合并，与多智能体系统研究相关，可为城市更新中多领域智能体的整合提供方法论指导。

item.title: Optimizing YOLO27, YOLO26, YOLO11, and YOLOv8 for Fine-Grained Small-Object Detection and Segmentation in Complex Orchard Environments
item.description:
中文标题：YOLOv26、YOLOv11和YOLOv8跨代优化用于复杂果园细粒度小目标检测与实例分割

作者：Ranjan Sapkota, Manoj Karkee

Abstract: ------------------------------------------------------------------------------

中文摘要：研究在苹果幼果、花萼和果梗的检测与分割任务上，对YOLOv8、YOLOv11和YOLOv26的五个模型规模进行了基准测试。结果显示，YOLOv11s-960在mask mAP@50:95上达到最高（0.402），而YOLOv26s-960以更少的参数（10.37M）取得了相当的性能（0.397），表明紧凑模型在小目标聚焦训练下更具效率优势。

研究启发（模型推断）：在精细农业或遥感小目标检测中，增加模型容量并非总是提升精度，针对小目标的输入分辨率和模型规模选择可能比单纯追求大模型更关键，这为资源受限的边缘计算场景提供了模型选型依据。

相关度：85/100 该研究系统对比了YOLOv8/11/26在复杂果园环境中的小目标检测与分割性能，其方法（多尺度训练、模型规模对比）和结论（紧凑模型更优）对您在多源数据融合和遥感变化检测中的目标识别任务具有直接参考价值。

item.title: On-Demand Attention: Language Models Know When to Recall
item.description:
中文标题：按需注意力：语言模型知道何时该回忆

作者：Haibo Feng, Ruiqi Liang, Hanyang Peng, Shiqi Yu

Abstract: Reasoning and agentic workloads increasingly demand efficient long-context inference. Yet full-attention decoding reads the growing history at every step, regardless of its benefit to the next prediction. We show that a pretrained model's decoding states already contain information predictive of this benefit, before the global read. Building on this finding, we introduce On-Demand Attention (ODA), a local-first decoding method that uses a lightweight recall head to selectively invoke global attention as its predicted benefit changes during generation. ODA trains only the recall head, leaving pretrained weights unchanged and the complete historical KV cache available for future recall. We further implement GPU-side conditional execution in vLLM, translating reduced global reads into practical decoding speedups over full attention at long context lengths. Experiments across Qwen and Gemma models, including hybrid-attention backbones, show that selective recall recovers most of the performance lost under local attention while substantially reducing global reads. These findings support long-context inference in which pretrained models guide their own access to the information they retain.

中文摘要：推理和智能体工作负载日益需要高效的长上下文推理。然而，全注意力解码在每一步都会读取不断增长的历史，而不考虑其对下一次预测的收益。作者表明，预训练模型的解码状态在全局读取之前就已包含可预测这种收益的信息。基于此发现，作者提出按需注意力（ODA），一种局部优先的解码方法，使用轻量级回忆头在生成过程中根据预测收益的变化选择性地调用全局注意力。ODA仅训练回忆头，保持预训练权重不变，并保留完整的历史KV缓存以供未来回忆。作者进一步在vLLM中实现GPU端条件执行，将减少的全局读取转化为长上下文长度下相对全注意力的实际解码加速。在Qwen和Gemma模型（包括混合注意力骨干）上的实验表明，选择性回忆恢复了局部注意力下损失的大部分性能，同时大幅减少全局读取。这些发现支持预训练模型自主引导其访问所保留信息的长上下文推理。

研究启发（模型推断）：该工作提示，在需要处理长时序地理空间数据或多轮智能体交互的场景中，可借鉴其选择性全局读取思路来降低推理成本；但其验证限于语言模型基准，尚不涉及地理空间任务。

相关度：62/100 该文研究LLM长上下文推理中的按需注意力机制，与LLM和多智能体研究方向相关，但未涉及地理空间数据或城市更新应用。

item.title: Don't Mask the Environment: Observation Supervision Changes How Agents Explore Under RL
item.description:
中文标题：不要遮蔽环境：观测监督如何改变智能体在强化学习中的探索

作者：Juzheng Zhang, Disha Makhija, Manoj Ghuhan Arivazhagan, Vinayshekhar Bannihatti Kumar, Rashmi Gangadharaiah

Abstract: Agent trajectories record what an agent does and what happens next. Yet standard supervised fine-tuning (SFT) applies loss only to agent-authored action tokens, using environment observations as context but not as prediction targets. We ask whether this convention provides the best initialization for subsequent reinforcement learning. We introduce ActObs, which also supervises the observation tokens already present in each trajectory. Although deployed agents never generate observations, learning to predict them encourages the policy to model action consequences without adding data, parameters, sequence tokens, or forward passes. The methods perform similarly after SFT but diverge after GRPO. On Qwen3-4B, GRPO from ActObs achieves higher pass@k at every evaluated sampling budget than its action-only counterpart on Terminal-Bench 2.0. On Qwen3-8B, it trades some pass@1 reliability for higher pass@k (+3.4 pp at pass@16) and solves more distinct tasks. The advantage extends to cross-domain code editing on aider-polyglot (+4.2 pp at pass@1 at 4B), whose tasks are unseen during SFT and RL. ActObs retains more entropy during RL while requiring less policy movement, leaving the final policy closer to its SFT initialization. Our analysis traces this difference to SFT: action and observation gradients rapidly become orthogonal, while action-only training leaves a large residual observation gradient and degrades environment prediction below the base model. Joint supervision prevents this one-sided specialization, preserving consequence prediction and preparing the policy for downstream exploration.

中文摘要：智能体轨迹记录了智能体的行为及其后续结果。然而标准监督微调（SFT）仅对智能体生成的动作token施加损失，将环境观测作为上下文而非预测目标。作者探究这一惯例是否为后续强化学习提供了最佳初始化。作者提出ActObs，同时对每条轨迹中已有的观测token进行监督。尽管部署的智能体从不生成观测，学习预测观测可促使策略建模动作后果，且不增加数据、参数、序列token或前向传播。两种方法在SFT后表现相似，但在GRPO后出现分化。在Qwen3-4B上，ActObs的GRPO在Terminal-Bench 2.0上每个评估采样预算下均取得比仅动作版本更高的pass@k。在Qwen3-8B上，它以部分pass@1可靠性换取更高的pass@k（pass@16时+3.4个百分点）并解决更多不同任务。该优势延伸至aider-polyglot上的跨域代码编辑（4B时pass@1 +4.2个百分点），其任务在SFT和RL中均未见过。ActObs在RL期间保留更多熵，同时需要更少的策略移动，使最终策略更接近其SFT初始化。作者的分析将这一差异追溯到SFT：动作和观测梯度迅速变得正交，而仅动作训练留下较大的残差观测梯度，使环境预测退化至低于基础模型。联合监督防止了这种单侧特化，保留了后果预测能力并为下游探索做好准备。

研究启发（模型推断）：该工作表明监督环境观测可改善智能体的后果建模与探索，这一思路或可迁移至地理空间智能体中让模型学习预测环境状态变化，但论文未涉及地理空间任务。

相关度：55/100 该文研究智能体在RL中的探索与观测监督，与LLM和多智能体研究方向相关，但未涉及地理空间或城市应用。

item.title: Digital Twins for Opinion Dynamics: A Generative LLM Framework for Social Networks
item.description:
中文标题：观点动力学的数字孪生：面向社交网络的生成式LLM框架

作者：Omran Berjawi, Giuseppe Fenza, Rida Khatoun, Sherali Zeadally

Abstract: The study of opinion dynamics in social networks is one of the key challenges in computational social science with direct relevance to understanding political polarization, misinformation, and health responses. Current approaches focus on simplified mathematical models that ignore linguistic and contextual factors related to belief updates or use Large Language Model (LLM)-based simulations that have not been validated against real data. We present a framework based on the concept of a digital twin to simulate opinion dynamics in social networks. The approach fills the gap by cloning a real-world Twitter network, assigns a set of attributes for agents (such as persona, emotions, centrality, stubbornness, and influence), and employs Mistral-7B to perform opinion update based on memory and social exposure. To evaluate the proposed approach, we validate it against two real Twitter datasets (COVID-19 discourse and U.S elections 2020). The results show that the capability of the proposed framework reproduces opinion trajectories and reduces individual prediction error by more than 50% compared to the best-performing classical baseline (Mistral-7B achieves Mean Absolute Error (MAE) = 0.150 and 0.121 on the COVID-19 and US Election 2020 datasets, respectively). We observe similar improvements in structural alignment (Delta_r = 0.120 and 0.180) and polarization dynamics (Delta_Var = 0.106 and 0.115) on the two datasets, respectively. Additionally, the ablation studies confirm that agent attributes, memory, and social exposure all contribute to the framework's predictive fidelity in reproducing opinion trajectories, with agent attributes being the most critical contributor. Overall, our results demonstrate that grounding Mistral-7B within empirically cloned interaction networks produces a realistic simulation framework capable of reproducing complex social dynamics.

item.content:encoded:
中文标题：观点动力学的数字孪生：面向社交网络的生成式LLM框架

作者：Omran Berjawi, Giuseppe Fenza, Rida Khatoun, Sherali Zeadally

Abstract: The study of opinion dynamics in social networks is one of the key challenges in computational social science with direct relevance to understanding political polarization, misinformation, and health responses. Current approaches focus on simplified mathematical models that ignore linguistic and contextual factors related to belief updates or use Large Language Model (LLM)-based simulations that have not been validated against real data. We present a framework based on the concept of a digital twin to simulate opinion dynamics in social networks. The approach fills the gap by cloning a real-world Twitter network, assigns a set of attributes for agents (such as persona, emotions, centrality, stubbornness, and influence), and employs Mistral-7B to perform opinion update based on memory and social exposure. To evaluate the proposed approach, we validate it against two real Twitter datasets (COVID-19 discourse and U.S elections 2020). The results show that the capability of the proposed framework reproduces opinion trajectories and reduces individual prediction error by more than 50% compared to the best-performing classical baseline (Mistral-7B achieves Mean Absolute Error (MAE) = 0.150 and 0.121 on the COVID-19 and US Election 2020 datasets, respectively). We observe similar improvements in structural alignment (Delta_r = 0.120 and 0.180) and polarization dynamics (Delta_Var = 0.106 and 0.115) on the two datasets, respectively. Additionally, the ablation studies confirm that agent attributes, memory, and social exposure all contribute to the framework's predictive fidelity in reproducing opinion trajectories, with agent attributes being the most critical contributor. Overall, our results demonstrate that grounding Mistral-7B within empirically cloned interaction networks produces a realistic simulation framework capable of reproducing complex social dynamics.

item.title: Constraint-Safe Graph-Context Scoring for Stable Point-Feature Labels Under Text-Width and Accessibility-Inspired Profiles
item.description:
中文标题：文本宽度与可访问性启发式配置下稳定点要素标注的约束安全图上下文评分

作者：Taimoor Ahmad

Abstract: Point-feature label placement on interactive maps must reconcile geometric validity, display yield, local placement utility, and stability across camera motion. Accessibility and multilingual requirements further change label dimensions, yet algorithmic evaluations often collapse these concerns into overlap counts. We present LABELSENSE-Pilot, a reproducible prototype that generates eight compass candidates per feature, scores candidates with a multilayer perceptron over graph-context summaries, adds a previous-placement bonus, and selects a layout through mixed-integer optimization. The executed scorer is deliberately not described as a graph transformer. Every returned layout is checked for viewport containment, per-feature uniqueness, and pairwise clearance. Experiments use 2,500 airport coordinates and names spanning 155 countries, with country-grouped splits and generated density, camera, text-suffix, preference, and enlarged-font stressors. Across five seeds, LABELSENSE-Pilot displayed 85.62 percent of labels with 2.09 percent flicker and zero collisions. Versus a handcrafted-utility integer program, LABELSENSE-Pilot sacrificed 1.43 percentage points of display while reducing flicker by 12.04 points. Enlarged-box-aware layouts produced zero proxy violations, whereas standard geometry reevaluated at 1.5x violated 52.57 percent of selected placements. These results establish an auditable engineering trade-off, not human accessibility, multilingual usability, or preference. Official recent baselines and participant evidence remain required before submission.

中文摘要：交互式地图上的点要素标注放置必须协调几何有效性、显示产出、局部放置效用以及相机运动下的稳定性。可访问性和多语言需求进一步改变标注尺寸，但算法评估常将这些关切简化为重叠计数。作者提出LABELSENSE-Pilot，一个可复现原型，为每个要素生成八个罗盘候选，用多层感知机基于图上下文摘要对候选评分，加入先前放置奖励，并通过混合整数优化选择布局。执行评分器刻意不被描述为图Transformer。每个返回布局都检查视口包含、每要素唯一性和成对间隙。实验使用横跨155个国家的2500个机场坐标和名称，采用按国家分组划分及生成的密度、相机、文本后缀、偏好和放大字体压力测试。在五个随机种子上，LABELSENSE-Pilot显示85.62%的标注，闪烁率2.09%，零碰撞。与手工效用整数规划相比，LABELSENSE-Pilot牺牲1.43个百分点的显示量，但将闪烁降低12.04个百分点。放大框感知布局产生零代理违规，而标准几何在1.5倍重新评估时52.57%的选定放置违规。这些结果确立了可审计的工程权衡，而非人类可访问性、多语言可用性或偏好。官方近期基线和参与者证据仍需在提交前补充。

研究启发（模型推断）：该原型展示了图上下文评分与混合整数优化结合在地图标注稳定性与可访问性权衡中的工程价值，其可审计的权衡框架对城市地图可视化与多语言标注系统设计有参考意义，但作者明确其结论不涉及人类可访问性验证。

相关度：55/100 该论文研究交互式地图上点要素标注放置问题，涉及图上下文评分、混合整数优化与地图可视化，属于GIS制图与空间优化范畴，与地理空间智能方向相关。

item.title: When AI Agents Commit: Cognitive Serializability Across Data, Evidence, Policy, and Authority
item.description:
中文标题：当AI智能体提交时：跨数据、证据、策略与权限的认知可串行化

作者：Jun He, Deying Yu

Abstract: Autonomous agents derive concrete mutations from database reads, retrieved evidence, policy, beliefs, and delegated authority. Those inputs may change while reasoning is in progress. Database isolation orders the submitted transaction; agentic transaction processing determines whether a proposal satisfies an executable contract. Neither guarantee establishes a common valid point for the mutation and its derivation inputs unless the contract represents the relevant predicates. Typed dependency tokens distinguish content integrity from applicability, and trusted mediation captures the values exposed to reasoning. Under strict Cognitive Serializability, committed effects admit a serial order and a logical event at which every value exposed to derivation is unchanged. The fences last until the runtime event that realizes the sealed durability domain. The weaker Effect-Compatible Cognitive Admission recertifies an effect against a simultaneously held current dependency vector and current policy without claiming to serialize the original stochastic derivation. TCT combines immutable versioned executable definitions, registry-derived authority plans, sealed envelopes, guard-first commit transactions, post-seal envelope- and witness-bound grants, co-committed receipts, idempotent grant finalization, and receipt-driven epistemic reconciliation. Complete registered footprints and a single growing phase induce an acyclic lock-point order over local guards and incompatible external reservations. The corresponding results give serializability conditions and an observational-equivalence boundary for zero-error soundness and positive progress. A falsification suite tests the implementation obligations: the prototype prevented all injected anomalies and added 3.22 ms mean commit overhead.

中文摘要：自主智能体从数据库读取、检索证据、策略、信念和委托权限中推导出具体变更，而这些输入可能在推理过程中发生变化。数据库隔离只能对已提交事务排序，智能体事务处理只能判断提案是否满足可执行契约；除非契约表示相关谓词，否则二者都无法为变更及其推导输入建立共同有效时点。类型化依赖令牌区分内容完整性与适用性，可信中介捕获暴露给推理的值。在严格认知可串行化下，已提交效果允许一个串行顺序，并存在一个逻辑事件，在该事件中暴露给推导的每个值都未改变。这些栅栏持续到实现密封持久域的运行时事件。较弱的“效果兼容认知准入”则针对同时持有的当前依赖向量和当前策略重新认证效果，而不声称对原始随机推导进行串行化。TCT结合了不可变版本化可执行定义、注册表派生的权限计划、密封信封、守卫优先提交事务、密封后信封与见证绑定的授权、共同提交收据、幂等授权最终化以及收据驱动的认知对账。完整的注册足迹和单一增长阶段在本地守卫与不兼容外部预留上诱导出无环锁点顺序。相应结果给出了可串行化条件以及零错误健全性与正向进展的观察等价边界。一个证伪测试套件检验实现义务：原型阻止了所有注入异常，并增加了3.22毫秒平均提交开销。

研究启发（模型推断）：该工作将智能体提交问题形式化为跨数据、证据、策略与权限的一致性契约问题，其类型化依赖令牌、可信中介与认知可串行化概念可为多智能体地理空间推理中的证据溯源、策略约束与提交一致性提供理论参考；但摘要未涉及地理空间数据、城市更新或遥感应用，因此对GIS研究的直接相关性有限。

相关度：62/100 该文研究自主智能体在数据库读取、检索证据、策略、信念与授权等输入变化下的提交一致性，提出认知可串行化与TCT机制，与LLM和多智能体系统的事务一致性、证据与策略协调直接相关，但未涉及地理空间数据或城市更新应用。

item.title: Can VLMs Reliably Assess Sidewalk Accessibility Attributes from Pedestrian-Level Imagery?
item.description:
中文标题：VLM能否可靠评估行人视角影像中的人行道无障碍属性？

作者：Seung Jae Lieu, Diego Morra, Chiara Cadoni, Wonseop Song, Martina Mazzarello, Carlo Ratti

Abstract: An important component of urban accessibility, particularly for wheelchair users and people with reduced mobility, is sidewalk compliance with measurable requirements. We test whether effective width, longitudinal slope, cross slope, and pavement condition can be assessed reliably from pedestrian-level imagery using vision-language models (VLMs). We present the first application of sampling-based conformal prediction (CP) for VLM-based accessibility assessment. We evaluate four VLMs on 514 sidewalk images from Seoul, South Korea, with field-measured ground truth. Conformal calibration attains the nominal 90% coverage for all models and attributes, but the calibrated regions differ in informativeness. Effective width yields the most informative estimates, with a mean interval half-width of about 1.0 m for the best model. Since every model overestimates width, asymmetric calibration shortens the intervals by up to 33% at unchanged coverage. Longitudinal slope is marginally informative, cross-slope intervals are too wide to resolve regulatory thresholds, and pavement-condition sets degenerate to all five grades (A-E) for three of the four models. Uncalibrated intervals from raw sampling dispersion cover only 17-47% of field-measured values at a nominal 90% level. Among the images with the most self-consistent responses, these intervals miss the field-measured value in up to 96% of cases. Response self-consistency is therefore not evidence of accuracy, and sampling dispersion cannot be interpreted as uncertainty until it has been calibrated against field-measured ground truth. No quantitative attribute reaches the precision required for general compliance assessment, but CP identifies from calibration data alone which attributes can support screening of segments far from the thresholds. We release the annotated pedestrian-level images and their corresponding field-measured attribute values.

中文摘要：城市无障碍的重要组成，尤其对轮椅使用者和行动不便者而言，是人行道对可测量要求的合规性。作者测试了有效宽度、纵向坡度、横向坡度和路面状况能否利用视觉语言模型（VLM）从行人视角影像可靠评估。作者提出了首个将基于采样的共形预测（CP）应用于VLM无障碍评估的研究。作者在韩国首尔514张人行道影像上评估四个VLM，并配有实地测量真值。共形校准在所有模型和属性上达到名义90%覆盖率，但校准区域的信息量不同。有效宽度产生最具信息量的估计，最佳模型的平均区间半宽约1.0米。由于所有模型都高估宽度，非对称校准在覆盖率不变的情况下将区间缩短最多33%。纵向坡度信息量有限，横向坡度区间过宽无法分辨监管阈值，路面状况对四个模型中的三个退化为全部五个等级（A-E）。来自原始采样离散度的未校准区间在名义90%水平下仅覆盖17-47%的实地测量值。在响应最自洽的图像中，这些区间在高达96%的案例中错过实地测量值。因此，响应自洽性不是准确性的证据，采样离散度在校准到实地测量真值之前不能解释为不确定性。没有定量属性达到一般合规评估所需的精度，但CP仅从校准数据就能识别哪些属性可以支持对远离阈值的路段进行筛查。

研究启发（模型推断）：该文将共形预测引入VLM城市无障碍评估，揭示了VLM在定量地理空间属性估计中的可靠性边界：自洽性不等于准确性，采样离散度需经实地真值校准。这对城市更新中的街景感知与多源数据融合具有直接方法启示，尤其是非对称校准可提升宽度估计效率，但坡度与路面状况尚不足以支撑合规判断。

相关度：72/100 该文利用行人视角影像和VLM评估人行道无障碍属性，属于城市感知与地理空间智能应用，与城市更新、街景影像分析和多源数据融合方向高度相关，且涉及不确定性量化方法。

中文标题：VLM能否可靠评估行人视角影像中的人行道无障碍属性？

作者：Seung Jae Lieu, Diego Morra, Chiara Cadoni, Wonseop Song, Martina Mazzarello, Carlo Ratti

Abstract: An important component of urban accessibility, particularly for wheelchair users and people with reduced mobility, is sidewalk compliance with measurable requirements. We test whether effective width, longitudinal slope, cross slope, and pavement condition can be assessed reliably from pedestrian-level imagery using vision-language models (VLMs). We present the first application of sampling-based conformal prediction (CP) for VLM-based accessibility assessment. We evaluate four VLMs on 514 sidewalk images from Seoul, South Korea, with field-measured ground truth. Conformal calibration attains the nominal 90% coverage for all models and attributes, but the calibrated regions differ in informativeness. Effective width yields the most informative estimates, with a mean interval half-width of about 1.0 m for the best model. Since every model overestimates width, asymmetric calibration shortens the intervals by up to 33% at unchanged coverage. Longitudinal slope is marginally informative, cross-slope intervals are too wide to resolve regulatory thresholds, and pavement-condition sets degenerate to all five grades (A-E) for three of the four models. Uncalibrated intervals from raw sampling dispersion cover only 17-47% of field-measured values at a nominal 90% level. Among the images with the most self-consistent responses, these intervals miss the field-measured value in up to 96% of cases. Response self-consistency is therefore not evidence of accuracy, and sampling dispersion cannot be interpreted as uncertainty until it has been calibrated against field-measured ground truth. No quantitative attribute reaches the precision required for general compliance assessment, but CP identifies from calibration data alone which attributes can support screening of segments far from the thresholds. We release the annotated pedestrian-level images and their corresponding field-measured attribute values.
